note: Set A is better because it correctly identifies the 'total thickness' values for the larger airfoils (360/25% and 301/44%) as ~90-100mm in multiple claims, whereas Set B frequently mislabels these total stack heights as 'CarbonUD thickness' or provides incorrect lower values (e.g., 40mm). Although Set A contains contradictions (claiming both 88mm and 40mm for the same airfoil's thickness) and misses the total thickness for the 77% span airfoil (claiming 10mm instead of 50mm), Set B's systematic error of attributing total height to specific materials makes it less faithful. Set A has fewer semantic binding errors despite some value inconsistencies.
